subject: Regarding your upcoming flight reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], we hope this email finds you well. We wanted to confirm your flight reservation from New York to London on June 15th, 2022. Please review the attached itinerary for details on your departure time, gate number, and any updates. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out to our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you onboard. Safe travels!
